title: Quarterly charter: Hosted Endpoints & Model Registry harmonization
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Objective: Produce a prioritized, executable quarterly charter that aligns the Hosted API endpoint roadmap with the model registry (catalog) lifecycle so customers have predictable model availability, clear deprecation windows, and reduced surprise substitutions.

Scope: This ticket captures cross-functional planning for the next quarter: endpoint product milestones (new conversational routes, structured-output anchors, streaming improvements) and model catalog actions (onboarding cadence, variant gating, retirement windows). Work includes stakeholder alignment, a decision ladder for replacement/rollback logic, and an OKR mapping to measure impact on latency/availability/cost.

Success metrics: 1) Publish a sprint-level roadmap with milestones and owners by end of Cycle 2026-W04; 2) Reduce unexpected model substitutions in hosted endpoints by 60% vs last quarter (tracked via deployment audit); 3) Define canary windows and SLO rollback thresholds for at least three top-tier models; 4) OKR: improve median token latency for high-throughput routes by 10% through catalog + serving coordination.

Key stakeholders: Product (Aisha, Luca), Engineering (runtime: Priya, infra: Mateo), Design (Sofia), Reliability (Jordan), Sales & CS (Katrina), Research/Applied ML (Dr. Elena Ivanov).

Deliverables: - Quarterly roadmap doc (Confluence) with milestones, owners, and decision ladder; - Model catalog gating policy draft (policy + rollout plan); - Canary scheduling grid and fallback mapping for hosted endpoints; - Stakeholder sign-off and internal kickoff.

Timeline & checkpoints: - Jan 5: Kickoff and initial discovery (this ticket created) - Jan 12: Draft roadmap + dependency heatmap (current update) - Jan 19: Cross-functional review with ENG/Reliability - Jan 26: Finalize gating policy and publish Confluence charter - Feb 2: Operationalize canary schedules with ENG on-call - Mar 31: End-of-quarter playbook and retrospective.

Risks and mitigations: - Risk: Model packaging delays from research -> mitigation: define minimum acceptance checklist and hold weekly syncs with Applied ML. - Risk: Capacity conflicts during canaries -> mitigation: reserve dedicated small-capacity windows and fallback model variants. - Risk: Misalignment on deprecation windows across teams -> mitigation: decision ladder enforces explicit approval steps and automatic notification cadence.

Artifacts: Draft roadmap & decision ladder: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Hosted+Endpoint+Model+Registry+Quarterly+Charter; Gating policy draft (Google Doc): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/hosted-catalog/q1-charter; Canary scheduling spreadsheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/1CanaryGrid; Reference PR for structured output route: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1428

Notes: This charter emphasizes a small set of measurable changes rather than a large feature surface to reduce operational risk while proving the cross-functional coordination pattern for future quarters.
